KIT-001.action: Extract the complete kit and run the integrity verifier before the preflight.

OS-001.action: Use a supported operating system and edition. Do not force a READY verdict on an unsupported platform.

ARCH-001.action: Install software matching the operating-system architecture.

PATH-001.action: Open a new terminal and inspect every resolved executable path.

PATH-002.action: Remove ambiguity between competing Node/npm installations; do not delete files at random.

NODE-001.action: Install Node.js v24.21.0 from an official or approved source, then reopen the terminal.

NPM-001.action: Use npm 11.19.0 supplied by the required Node installation.

CACHE-001.action: Check whether npm can resolve its cache path without changing it automatically.

UTF8-001.action: Use a UTF-8 locale/editor and keep repository text as UTF-8 without BOM where specified.

WRITE-001.action: Move the kit to a local writable directory and retry.

GIT-001.action: Install a maintained Git release and reopen the terminal.

GIT-002.action: Configure a real name and a verified email address.

VSC-001.action: Install VS Code Stable or expose the existing installation to the shell.

VSC-002.action: Install the required Prettier and ESLint extensions.

BROWSER-001.action: Install a current Chrome, Edge or Chromium release.

LOCALHOST-001.action: Run the localhost diagnostic and inspect firewall or endpoint policy.

POSTMAN-001.action: Install Postman Desktop before week 5; it is not required on Day 0.

SQLITE-001.action: Install SQLite CLI before week 6; it is not required on Day 0.

ACCOUNT-001.action: Verify the GitHub account and email, then acknowledge the check explicitly.

ACCOUNT-002.action: Enable GitHub 2FA and confirm Gemini Web access without sharing credentials.
